---
name: Propose a new skill, agent, rule, or workflow
about: Something this toolkit should cover but doesn't yet
title: "[New] "
labels: enhancement
---

## What's missing

- [ ] Skill (`skills/dotnet/...` or `skills/agentic-ai/...`)
- [ ] Agent (`agents/`)
- [ ] Rule (`rules/`)
- [ ] Workflow (`workflows/`)
- [ ] Prompt (`prompts/`)
- [ ] Adapter (`adapters/`) for a platform not yet covered

## Why this needs to be a new file, not an addition to an existing one

Per `CONTRIBUTING.md`'s no-duplication rule: if this overlaps an existing
file by more than a paragraph, it should probably extend that file instead
of becoming a new one. Explain why that's not the case here.

## Proposed scope

What it should cover, and — for a skill — its `domain` (`dotnet` or
`agentic-ai`), its likely `requires`/`related`/`optional` relationships to
existing skills, and its `triggers`.

## Who would use it

Which existing agent(s) would load it, or whether it implies a new agent
role is also needed.
